body_lead: Gandhinagar (Gujarat) [India], August 7 (ANI): The Gujarat government on Friday notified the Viksit Gujarat Data Centre Policy 2026-29, aiming to establish the state as a leading hub for hyperscale Green AI data centres and next-generation digital infrastructure. The policy targets the creation of 7.5 GW of hyperscale Green AI data centre capacity in Gujarat to meet the growing demand for artificial intelligence, cloud computing, high-performance computing and digital services.
